day_shape: 69 items: Iran-US-Qatar-Pakistan 'Lake Lucerne' four-party talks open then break after 80 minutes with Vance present, IDF exposes Hezbollah drone tunnel in Majdal Zoun, fourth IDF soldier named killed in south Lebanon, armed boarding attempt 50nm off Yemen, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Lake Lucerne four-party talks open
threads.summary: Iranian, US, Qatari and Pakistani delegations convened the 'Lake Lucerne Meeting' in Bürgenstock, Switzerland, with Qalibaf, Araghchi and Hamti facing VP JD Vance before journalists were ejected at Qalibaf's insistence. Regime channels said the session was suspended after 80 minutes for internal consultations and that Article 13 of the Islamabad understanding — focused on Lebanon — was the agenda, not the nuclear file.

threads.label: Reactions to US-Iran MoU
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump described the signed Washington-Tehran deal as Iran's 'unconditional surrender,' while northern-border Israelis voiced fears the MoU leaves them exposed to Hezbollah and former chief rabbi Yitzhak Yosef called it divine retribution. Iran International reported hardline outlets accusing the Iranian negotiating team of disregarding Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's objections, and Khamenei's office posted that 'we await fulfilment of the stated conditions.'

threads.label: IDF operations in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF's 91st Division 551st Brigade said it had seized a 200m-long, 25m-deep Hezbollah tunnel under Majdal Zoun containing four launch shafts, 12 rooms and an Iranian-built drone 'airbase,' while Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visited forces operating in Ali Taher and Beaufort. Staff Sgt. Nave Habshoosh, 20, was named as the fourth soldier killed in Friday's Hezbollah tank strike, and reports said IDF troops had cornered Hezbollah operatives in Tebnit.

threads.label: Hezbollah and Lebanon casualties
threads.summary: Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem said via IRIB and Defa Press that Iran and the IRGC stood behind the resistance and that Netanyahu launched the anti-Iran war with Trump's backing, while Defa Press claimed seven killed in Lebanon despite a ceasefire and Al-Manar reported a 24-hour halt to fighting credited to Iranian negotiators. Jerusalem Post cited an ITIC assessment of weakening Shiite support for Hezbollah and reported turtle conservationist Mona Khalil died of injuries from an airstrike on her southern Lebanon home.

threads.label: Maritime: Yemen incident, oil flows, US carrier
threads.summary: UKMTO reported an armed speedboat attempted to board a commercial vessel 50 nautical miles south-east of Yemen's eastern coast, with Defa Press identifying the target as an oil tanker and noting at least four other armed attacks on commercial shipping in Yemeni waters over the past two weeks. CENTCOM posted that USS Abraham Lincoln continues to operate in the Arabian Sea, and the NIOC CEO claimed on IRIB that Iranian ships had moved 25 million barrels of oil past 'the imaginary blockade line' in one week.

threads.label: Hamas Turkey network exposed
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet named five Hamas operatives directing dozens of foiled West Bank attacks from Turkish soil, including recruitment and weapons transfers via the group's 'West Bank Headquarters.' The military also said Wednesday's Gaza strike killed Hussein Qadra and Mohammed Farra, accused of routing more than half a billion shekels to Hamas's military wing through couriers and money exchangers in Turkey and Gaza.

threads.label: Iran domestic: prosecutions, sentences, services
threads.summary: Iran's Attorney General said on IRIB that more than 200 cases had been filed in special criminal sections against 'war criminals who waged war on Iran' and announced a Judiciary task force on resistant-economy policies, while Bushehr offices shifted to 6:30am-12pm hours and Kish airport was cleared to resume flights. Times of Israel reported singer Parastoo Ahmadi and seven fellow artists were sentenced to 74 lashes each over a livestreamed YouTube performance.
